turns.question: What was our real revenue in the first ten days of October 2026?
turns.answer: Revenue (the sum of non-cancelled orders' amounts, our one definition of revenue) was 2,137.34 EUR for 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-10. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
